about: Spine and periphery theorems that stand apart from the base by design (U, 17 October 2026; the periphery of the run, the foundation and the inherited modules the bridge imports, since U2). Each root (an apart theorem no other apart theorem uses) has a category and a reason; THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY.py --check fails where an apart root has none. The categories: The F3 sweep (19 October 2026) removed the 218 entries whose modules left the run (superseded periphery modules, bridge and join modules); they are kept in the bridge-fold workspace, apart-retired.json.

categories.support: an arithmetic or list lemma, a statement using only the prelude, or a one-line unpacking of a module's own definitions
categories.logical-strength: a statement about LPO, WLPO, LLPO, excluded middle or choice only
categories.model-witness: a fact about one constructed model (a counterexample or example structure)
categories.restates: it restates a law already stated on the base
categories.general-structure: a law of every valuation or rule on any type; the base supplies no reading of its vocabulary
categories.bridge-interface: an equivalence between an inherited periphery interface and a core concept (the bridge ring)
categories.axiom-dependent: a periphery root whose own axiom report is not empty, so no join on the pure bridge can use it
categories.periphery-scope: a statement about a periphery module's own abstract interface with no evident reading as a process, run or world; the reason names the core concept the bridge identifies it with, or says there is none
categories.calibration: the exact logical principle (excluded middle, LPO, WLPO, choice) a stated criterion needs, for a notion the base does not assert; a lemma of the item that needs it

Becoming.Ideals.Closed.hull_iff.reason: A closed class is its own hull: `hull_least` with `hull_contains`, a one-line unpacking; at runs, a reading holding every run adhering to it holds exactly those runs, and adhering itself is the least closed class (`Stretches.adheres_iff_closed`).

Becoming.Ideals.Ideal.Same.trans.reason: Transitivity of holding the same stretches, a one-line lemma of the module's own definitions.

Becoming.Ideals.Preorder.Equiv.refl.reason: Reflexivity of an order's equivalence (each element below itself both ways), a one-line lemma of the module's own definitions.

Becoming.Ideals.avoids_principal_iff.reason: A finite history avoids `F` exactly where no element of `F` lies below its stretch: the definition of `Avoids` unpacked (`Iff.rfl`).

Becoming.Ideals.content_false.reason: The empty class has no content: a one-line unpacking of `Content`.

Becoming.Ideals.false_closed.reason: The empty class is closed: a one-line unpacking of `Closed` (a directed set of ideals is nonempty).

Becoming.Ideals.false_refutable.reason: The empty class is refuted at any stretch of any ideal: a one-line unpacking of `Refutable`.

Becoming.Ideals.within_false.reason: No ideal lies within the empty set of stretches, since an ideal has a stretch: a one-line unpacking.

Becoming.Ideals.restrict_false_none.reason: The empty set's order has no ideal: a one-line unpacking of `Ideal.nonempty`.

Becoming.Ideals.hull_hull.reason: The hull's idempotence, `AdheresBy.adheres` read on the hull; its case of runs is Horizon's `Adheres.adheres` (a run adhering to the runs that adhere to a reading adheres to it), already on the base.

Becoming.Ideals.hull_iff_within_content.reason: The hull is the class within the content: the two definitions unpacked (`Iff.rfl`); at runs it is `adheres_iff_adheresBy`.

Becoming.Ideals.idealOrder_equiv_iff.reason: Equivalence in the order of ideals is holding the same stretches: a one-line unpacking of `idealOrder`.

Becoming.Ideals.lower_unique_of_two.reason: Two lower sets giving one class are the same set: `lower_unique` applied twice, a one-line corollary.

Becoming.Ideals.sup_congr.reason: Directed suprema of two sets holding the same elements are equivalent: the fields of `DirectedComplete` unpacked; the histories of a process are such an order (`idealComplete`).

Becoming.Ideals.sup_mono.reason: A directed supremum lies below that of a larger directed set: the fields of `DirectedComplete` unpacked.

Becoming.HistoryIdeals.classification.reason: The case of words of `Stretches.classification`, which states for the histories of every process that one settling, or going on with a stretch beyond each horizon picked, is a finite history or the history of a run; on the process of all sequences its stretches and the words are one order read two ways (`HistoryIdeals.sequence_stretch_iff`, `Stretches.sequences_le_iff`).

Becoming.HistoryIdeals.principal_settles.reason: The case of words of `Stretches.principal_settles` (a finite history settles), stated on the base for every process.

Becoming.HistoryIdeals.trace_goesOn.reason: The case of words of `Stretches.run_goesOn` (a run's history goes on), stated on the base for every process.
